task.cardTitle: State-Driven Mandatory Closeout and Fail-Closed Review Surface Delivery

unauthorizedScope: modify Sol Advisor / model routing / reviewer selection
designDecisions: R1/R3: review requirement is a persisted autoloop.closeout-state/v1 record; runStateDrivenCloseout is the SINGLE script-free production trigger, wired into runColimaGraph at card completion via closeout.statePath. Legacy in-memory requiresReview path unchanged.
R2: materializeCloseoutContract fails closed as CLOSEOUT_METADATA_INCOMPLETE when task identity/outDir is missing — never a silent skip, never a PASS.

R4/R5/R6: runCloseoutGate now treats delivery as part of success — AWAITING_BUNDLE_DELIVERY propagates to top-level non-PASS; the fixed-surface channel is re-verified (identity + recomputed SHA + delivery record) before a PASS.

R7: deliverToExternalReviewSurface auto-rotates a RESOLVED occupant (verdict bound to its own bundle) under the same publication lock before publishing the next card; an UNRESOLVED occupant still blocks (surface_occupied). No verdict is ever auto-generated.

Idempotency: runStateDrivenCloseout records the disposition back into the state record; an APPLIED+PASS state is skipped on re-entry; a non-PASS disposition is retryable with the same deterministic bundle identity.
negativeCases: surface write failure -> top-level final AWAITING_BUNDLE_DELIVERY (never PASS) — T4
occupied unresolved surface -> blocked, old artifact untouched — T5
missing closeout metadata -> CLOSEOUT_METADATA_INCOMPLETE, no report, no PASS — T2
crash between generation and delivery -> resume recovers deterministically, single artifact, same identity — T7

regression.suite: test:governance (full governance suite, incl. new lifecycle tests)

regressionSummary: state-driven closeout lifecycle tests 12/12; full governance 241/241; graph-closeout integration 2/2; lifecycle-runner set 43/43. Colima-dependent suites (colima-all 43/43, test:v2 372/372) were green at the DE-2R closeout and are unaffected by this additive change; not re-run in this session (colima environment unavailable).
objective: Close the lifecycle gap: review-required lifecycle state -> mandatory closeout materialization -> bundle generation -> validation -> Current/ delivery -> external-review waiting state, driven by structured state instead of a remembered card-specific script; and make required delivery failure produce a top-level non-PASS closeout.
recommendedNextStep: Controller external review of this card's bundle (AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW on Current/); then FM-3 bounded repair card for authorized/touched/inventory consistency.
